descriptions: This dataset contains 2 audio recordings (1 item) with Buṭrus Buṭrus Ghālī and Joseph E. Connor on reforms within the United Nations (UN).
The interview is conducted in English and Arabic. The summary of the recordings and the metadata are presented in English.
